org.smtlib
This package contains the main classes and abstract interfaces for this SMT-LIB tool; the tool provides a stand-alone SMT-LIB-compliant command-line application, an application that responds to SMT-LIB commands over a network port, and an SMT-LIB Java API.

    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    ISolver
    SMT.Configuration.createSolver(String solvername, String executable)
    Resolves the given solver name and executable to a concrete ISolver adapter instance, applying the same name/executable/adapter resolution jsmtlib.properties supports as SMT.startSolver(org.smtlib.SMT.Configuration, java.lang.String, java.lang.String) -- platform-specific .adapter/.exec overrides checked before their bare counterparts, the Solver_<name> naming convention, the z3-specific Solver_z3_recent fallback for an unrecognized z3 variant, the generic Solver_smt fallback, the "test" pseudo-solver special case, and %exec% command-array placeholder substitution -- but, unlike startSolver, this method does not start the solver and does not do any CLI-flavored error()/usage() reporting: any resolution or construction failure is reported as a thrown ISolver.CreationException instead, leaving it to the caller to start the returned solver (via ISolver.start()) and decide how to report a creation failure.
